storyCards.headline: Hit That: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Offspring's "Hit That" reached #64 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Hit That" is a song by American rock band the Offspring, included as the fourth track on the band's seventh studio album, Splinter (2003), and was released as its first single.

The song peaked at #64 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

Hit That was released in 2003.
